payload.reason: The evidence provides specific correlations between different ROUGE variants and their effectiveness in summarization evaluation, particularly in relation to human judgments.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in varying correlation values with human judgments, indicating that not all ROUGE scores are equally effective.
ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 are better correlated with manual judgments in the context of scientific summarization compared to other variants.
Many ROUGE variants do not have high correlations with human pyramid scores, suggesting their limited reliability for scientific summarization.
The lowest F-score correlations are observed for ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L, indicating their weaker performance.
